description: A young woman chef with short black hair and hoop earrings, in a white chef's jacket, stands in a busy restaurant kitchen holding a big steel bowl and looking up at fresh leafy greens, kale and spinach leaves flying through the air above her. The leaves fall down into her bowl, and she lowers her eyes and smiles with the bowl full of greens. Behind her two male cooks work at the stoves, steam rises from a pot on the left, copper pans hang overhead and piles of green leaves lie on the steel counter.

taps.phrase: to gaze up at flying leaves
